annotations.title: Create a paused ad campaign (lead, message, website traffic or conversions)

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Creates a Meta Instant Form lead campaign (goal lead_generation, the ad set's leadGenFormId from ads_lead_forms_list, placements without Audience Network, the age range and countries in targeting) with one image ad, or video ads, created PAUSED. It lands in the owner's Proposed campaigns and never runs or spends until the owner approves it (ads_campaign_approve). headline, body, one creative and budget (dollars; budgetType daily or lifetime) are required. The creative is one of: imageUrl (https on an allowed host: *.convex.cloud, img.clerk.com, ui-avatars.com, images.unsplash.com, *.googleusercontent.com, cdn.shopify.com, commerce.mdostal.com, shop.mdostal.com; anything else, upload it with POST /api/v2/media/upload-url), imageMediaId (that upload's storageId), creativeId, video, or videos (several video ads in one ad set for an A/B test, each { mediaId | contentId | metaVideoId, name?, thumbnailUrl? }). placements: automatic (default), facebook, instagram, facebook_instagram, feeds, reels, stories, or { platforms, surfaces }; never Audience Network. savedTargetingId reuses a saved audience (Ads > Audiences) under your own targeting; interest ids come from ads_targeting_search. promotedObject.pageId picks the Facebook Page. goal messages instead creates a click-to-message ad (Messenger + Instagram Direct, imageUrl only, no form): the brand's automatic first reply greets people with quick replies tagged with armKey, and each conversation lands as a lead with its ad/arm attribution; also PAUSED and proposed. goal traffic or conversions (FFE-1537) creates a website campaign that sends people to targetUrl (required; UTM parameters are added from the owner's ads config): the same creative sources, or creatives (several image ads in one ad set, each { imageUrl | imageMediaId | creativeId, headline?, body?, description?, linkUrl?, name? }), plus description (the line under the headline) and callToAction. conversions optimizes for a pixel event on the brand's selected pixel (promotedObject.customEventType, default COMPLETE_REGISTRATION) and is refused with code PIXEL_NOT_PROVEN unless the readiness check `pixel` passes: read ads_readiness with objective conversions first and tell the user what it says to fix. platform tiktok with goal traffic or conversions creates a TikTok video campaign on the brand's connected TikTok ad account instead (video or videos as { libraryItemId | storageId }, a daily budget, schedule.endDate, targeting.countries, an https targetUrl, and promotedObject.pixelId for conversions); it answers 403 until the owner's admin has enabled TikTok ad creation. Every campaign from this tool is PAUSED and proposed; a budget above the owner's caps is refused. Pass agentName and reason. Audited in Ads > Agent activity.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/campaigns.)

adAccountId.description: Default: the brand's selected ad account; must match it.

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

aiDisclosure.description: Mark the video ads as AI-generated (set automatically for flayr AI videos).

armKey.description: messages only: the test arm in each quick-reply payload and lead (default: from the headline).

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

budget.description: In dollars (account currency). Above the owner's spend caps or the account limit the create is refused (400). platform tiktok: dollars per day.

budgetType.description: Default lifetime. platform tiktok: daily only.

callToAction.description: A CTA from the ads create config (default: the owner's default, e.g. LEARN_MORE; SIGN_UP suits a lead form).

creativeId.description: lead_generation, traffic, conversions: a saved ad creative id instead of imageUrl. A website campaign uses its image only; the copy and link are this request's.

creatives.description: traffic / conversions on Meta: several image ads in one ad set, up to the ads create config cap. Instead of the single-creative fields, not with them.

items.description: Exactly one of imageUrl, imageMediaId or creativeId; copy left out is the campaign's own.

description.description: traffic / conversions on Meta: the line under the headline (link description).

destinationId.description: traffic / conversions: on an ad account under the landing destination registry, the registered destination to send people to; the registry then sets targetUrl.

goal.description: lead_generation (Instant Form), messages (click-to-message, Messenger + Instagram Direct), traffic (link clicks to targetUrl) or conversions (a pixel event on targetUrl).

idempotencyKey.description: Optional; repeats with the same key return the first result instead of creating twice.

imageMediaId.description: lead_generation, traffic, conversions: a flayr upload (the storageId POST /api/v2/media/upload-url returns) instead of imageUrl.

imageUrl.description: The ad image, https on an allowed host: *.convex.cloud, img.clerk.com, ui-avatars.com, images.unsplash.com, *.googleusercontent.com, cdn.shopify.com, commerce.mdostal.com, shop.mdostal.com. For any other image, upload it and send imageMediaId. Send exactly one of imageUrl, imageMediaId, creativeId, video, videos.

leadGenFormId.description: lead_generation only, and required there: an Instant Form id (GET /api/v2/ads/lead-forms).

placements.description: Default automatic = Facebook, Instagram and Messenger. Audience Network is never used. feeds/reels/stories (or { surfaces }) pick those positions on Facebook and Instagram.

platform.description: Default facebook. tiktok (traffic / conversions only) creates a TikTok video campaign on the brand's connected TikTok ad account.

promotedObject.description: lead_generation: pageId, the Facebook Page the lead ad runs from. conversions: customEventType, the pixel event to optimize for (Meta defaults to COMPLETE_REGISTRATION; TikTok accepts its optimization event, e.g. ON_WEB_REGISTER), and optionally pixelId, which on Meta must be the brand's selected pixel and on TikTok is required. Not accepted with traffic on Meta.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

savedTargetingId.description: lead_generation, traffic, conversions (Meta): a saved audience id (the id in the Ads > Audiences page URL). Its targeting is the base; fields in `targeting` override it.

schedule.description: ISO dates; default now to +7 days. platform tiktok: endDate is required.

smartPlus.description: TikTok only, opt-in after admin enablement; requires conversions with a pixel and event.

targetUrl.description: traffic / conversions only, and required there: the page the ad sends people to (https on TikTok). On Meta the owner's UTM template is appended; TikTok can carry UTM parameters directly in targetUrl.

targeting.description: Age range 13-65 and the usual targeting fields.

video.description: Meta: exactly one of mediaId, contentId or metaVideoId. TikTok: exactly one of libraryItemId or storageId.

metaVideoId.description: Meta: a video already in the selected ad account.

name.description: The ad name; defaults to the headline, numbered for multiple ads.

videos.description: Several video ads in one ad set, up to the ads create config cap. Each is created PAUSED; a failed attachment is reported in ads and does not undo the campaign.

items.description: Meta: exactly one of mediaId, contentId or metaVideoId. TikTok: exactly one of libraryItemId or storageId.

metaVideoId.description: Meta: a video already in the selected ad account.

name.description: The ad name; defaults to the headline, numbered for multiple ads.

name: ads_campaign_create
